🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, meeting the Sector Strength threshold; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5). Confirmation is mixed: nine sectors advanced, but Technology was weakest at -7.18% for the week and risk/cycle signals are N/A.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary led (+3.48% 1W), with GM (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +10.11%) and LOW (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +19.63%) ABOVE TREND. Communication (+2.90%) followed, with CHTR (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +5.59%) and CMCSA (1W: +8.38% | 1M: +11.44%) ABOVE TREND; Real Estate ranked third at +2.85%, though constituent-level returns were not supplied.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology was weakest (-7.18% 1W; -9.07% 1M), with INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.65% | 1M: -19.18%) BELOW TREND. Energy was also negative (-1.89% 1W); XOM (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +8.21%) and CVX (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +9.11%) are in CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), GM (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +10.11%), CRH (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +13.16%) and CHTR (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +5.59%), all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%), NOW (1W: -29.47% | 1M: -19.78%), SHOP (1W: -14.02% | 1M: -10.95%), AMD (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -23.40%) and PANW (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -13.91%), all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%) and GM (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +10.11%), all ABOVE TREND. Divergence: META (1W: +0.14% | 1M: -16.29%) is in RECOVERY, while TSLA (1W: -2.20% | 1M: +5.22%) is in CORRECTION.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns at -7.18% 1W and -9.07% 1M; the number of advancing stocks among its 24 constituents was not provided. NVDA (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -13.48%), GOOGL (1W: -12.65% | 1M: -19.18%) and INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%) are BELOW TREND; META (1W: +0.14% | 1M: -16.29%) is in RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained +1.67% for the week and +4.22% for the month; constituent-level positive breadth was not supplied. MA (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +14.80%), V (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +13.72%) and JPM (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +2.19%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare advanced +1.98% 1W and +9.27% 1M; constituent-level positive breadth was not supplied. LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%) and PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +9.45%) are ABOVE TREND, while JNJ (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +5.23%) and UNH (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +6.83%) are in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor relative strength across sectors rather than a concentrated style trade: the Top 5 leadership is broad, while Technology remains weak. Style mixed / no clear leadership; monitor exposure to INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%) and NOW (1W: -29.47% | 1M: -19.78%), both BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRH (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +13.16%), ABOVE TREND, if earnings strength sustains; PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +9.45%), ABOVE TREND, if raised guidance continues to support price. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%) and SHOP (1W: -14.02% | 1M: -10.95%), both BELOW TREND, with further weakness if demand concerns persist.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+3.48% 1W) and Materials (+2.65% 1W), both positive across the sector-level return measure; individual-stock breadth counts are unavailable. BEARISH: Technology (-7.18% 1W; -9.07% 1M) remains weakest, while Energy fell 1.89% for the week despite a positive monthly return.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Numeric price levels were not provided, so support and resistance cannot be stated reliably. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -13.48%), BELOW TREND, stabilizes; whether META (1W: +0.14% | 1M: -16.29%), in RECOVERY, follows through; and whether MA (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +14.80%), ABOVE TREND, sustains momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CRH (+70): earnings-call headline cites resilient growth and a $6 billion buyback; CRH (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +13.16%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. PFE (+50): raised guidance and cost savings; PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +9.45%) is ABOVE TREND, also confirming; AMD (+55): earnings beat and data-center growth, but AMD (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -23.40%) is BELOW TREND, a notable price/sentiment divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
SHOP (-45): Q3 results fell short of elevated expectations; SHOP (1W: -14.02% | 1M: -10.95%) is BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. INTC (-40): demand concerns; INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%) is BELOW TREND, confirming; CHTR (-50): price target reduced, but CHTR (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +5.59%) is ABOVE TREND, a sentiment/price divergence to monitor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with Style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Relative strength spans DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%) and LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), both ABOVE TREND. Monitor Technology weakness and the divergence between AMD’s positive earnings sentiment and its BELOW TREND price action (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -23.40%).
